messages.text:
<yellow>Interlevel Travel (choose a branch):<lightgrey>
 Use the shortcut letter for a branch to select the branch for travel.

 Once you select a branch, you will be prompted for a depth in that
 branch (more help is available there).

 <white>Tab<lightgrey>    : Repeat last interlevel travel.
 <white>.<lightgrey>      : Travel to a level in the current branch.
 <white><<<lightgrey>      : Go up the nearest stairs.
 <white>><lightgrey>      : Go down the nearest stairs.
 <white>Ctrl-P<lightgrey> : Travel to a level in the branch above this one.
 <white>*<lightgrey>      : Show available waypoints (if any are set).
 <white>0<lightgrey>-<white>9<lightgrey>    : Go to the numbered waypoint.
 <white>_<lightgrey>      : Show available altars (if any are discovered).
